card.name: Words after "man" in moral and rights texts
card.fires_on: Small words and verbs right after "man", "Christian" or a similar subject in religious, moral or rights-related passages. They sit in the middle of a statement about what a person must, may or has a right to do.

modes.label: Duty or right after a person
modes.description: The word after a subject like man or husband, in a statement of what that person is to do or may do.
modes.example: each man<< is>> to have his own wife, and each

modes.label: Freedom or action phrases
modes.description: A linking word or verb inside a phrase about freedom, rights or conduct.
modes.example: The freedom to run<< the>> program, for any purpose (freedom

modes.label: Inside a Latin phrase
modes.description: Partway through a Latin theological term.
modes.example: the term ex op<<ere>> operato (from the work done)

card.plain: It fires on the small word that follows a person in a moral or religious rule about what they must or may do.
